description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmployeeReportController class, which manages the rendering of the employee report edit/save component for the OrangeHRM system. It sets up properties for report id, selection criteria, display field groups, and display fields by fetching data through services and preparing components accordingly.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller class handling the setup and rendering of employee report save/edit Vue component, integrating report criteria, display fields, and localization.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and configures the Vue component for the employee report page, setting properties based on report ID, report generator data, and localization.
